verdict.rationale: Keycloak explicitly documents dedicated Authorization Services with resource-level, policy-based authorization (resources, scopes, policies, permission tickets via UMA) that go beyond simple RBAC, plus role-based, attribute-based, and other policy types, all manageable from admin console/API. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the fine-grained authorization services specifically (community evidence discusses other Keycloak aspects but not this feature).
